items.title: Emile Barnes Interview, 1962-01-03
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] How about Albert Burbank? Did you hear anything about him in the 20s?... [INTERVIEWEE] Well, I don't know no bands that were... Outside of the young bands when it started. Yeah, that's all I know.

ctx.x: Do you think anybody's gonna ever come back to that old style and play it again ever?

What, with the music? Yeah. Well, I'm gonna tell you something about that, Al. That's very easy to do. You catch the old man, Peter Barga, myself, old man, put him there. One or two days, make a rehearsal, just about two hours, catch some of the old music and go back and get it.
Yeah, but do you think any of the youngsters will ever get it?
